# Pena Studio

> Pena Studio is a small creative production house in Belgrade, Serbia, founded in 2025. It builds and runs its own digital products and spaces, and builds simple custom business apps for clients. It works in Serbian, English and Turkish.

Contact: penastudio@proton.me · WhatsApp +381 65 956 5675

## Products

- [Pena Tools](https://penastudio.cc/tools/): Simple custom apps for salons, gyms, workshops and shops, such as appointment booking or member check-in. The client approves the screen designs first, and the app is built in one day. Fixed one-time price of €250–750, with no monthly subscription; the client owns the app and its data. Live demos: [salon booking](https://penastudio.cc/tools/demo/salon/), [gym member passes](https://penastudio.cc/tools/demo/gym/).
- [Kreela](https://kreela.info/): A platform for booking a café or small space in Belgrade by the hour, every week or for a whole day, for workshops, clubs, language exchanges, shoots and private events. The venue confirms within 24 hours and the price is shown up front. In beta; Pena Art Cafe is the first venue joining.
- [Pena Art Cafe](https://www.penabeograd.art/): An art café in Belgrade with coffee, cocktails, comedy nights, weekly international meetups and a garden. Rated 5.0 from 65 Google reviews.
- [ForaComedy.Club](https://foracomedy.club/): A free online community and PWA that lists every stand-up comedy night in Belgrade in one place.
